ideal: Every push gets a trusted result within ten minutes from locked workflows, and included minutes last the cycle, free lanes first, no unneeded runs.

parts.ideal: Each workflow starts only when a file it checks changed, holds a read-only token, and a newer push cancels its older run
parts.setup: Add paths filters or a changes job, permissions contents: read at the top, concurrency with cancel-in-progress, and a timeout on each job

parts.ideal: Every install restores a cache keyed on its lockfile, and storage stays under the repo's 10 GB so nothing is evicted early
parts.setup: setup-node with cache: npm, or actions/cache keyed on hashFiles of the lockfile; entries unused for 7 days are removed

parts.ideal: Every workflow runs the action commits its lockfile records, and a workflow outside the lockfile cannot run
parts.setup: Run gh actions-lock, commit .github/workflows/actions.lock, check it in CI, then turn on the Require lockfile policy

parts.ideal: Light jobs run on ubuntu-slim at a third of the 2-core price, and free third-party minutes are used before included ones
parts.setup: ubuntu-slim for one-core jobs under 15 minutes; Blacksmith gives 3,000 and Ubicloud 1,250 free minutes a month; public repos run free

parts.ideal: Only the default branch deploys, through an environment, with OIDC in place of a stored secret
parts.setup: Create the environment and limit its deployment branches to the default branch; required reviewers on a private repo need Enterprise

parts.ideal: Included usage lasts the whole billing cycle, and the workflows and jobs that bill the most are trimmed first
parts.setup: Insights, Actions Usage Metrics by workflow, job and runner; a budget stops Actions at the included amount, which resets each cycle

parts.ideal: Jobs start within 30 seconds, few fail, and the pipeline goes green within ten minutes
parts.setup: Insights, Actions Performance Metrics: run time, queue time and failures by workflow and job; this tab scores job wait and failed runs

parts.ideal: Every release, binary or package people download carries signed build provenance; test builds carry none
parts.setup: actions/attest with id-token: write, attestations: write and contents: read; consumers run gh attestation verify
